tweets.text:
And of course we can’t forget 4 Attack Kingambit - the 2nd most used Mon in the format behind Life Orb Garchomp

It’s just so good into Basc, Sylve, Gambit, Ghold, TTar, etc. it does it all

And having multiple offensive mons to handle opposing threats is crucial (8/10)

Speaking of Glimmora, it’s Glim Time!
Remember in Reg M-A where it was like everywhere? 

Well it’s back and Power Gem + Earth Power + Sludge Bomb still punishes Zard, Aero, and Floette while also threatening new threats like Raichu Y, Arcanine-H and opposing Staraptor (7/10)

Okay let’s talk the Mon that is the glue for this entire team: Whimsicott!

The combination of Tailwind + Charm + Light Screen solves a lot of the problems that Delphox and Staraptor have had earlier in the format. 

They’ve been too slow to get going and get blown up early(4/10)

And I think an overlooked aspect of this team is that both Megas let you click EQ with Life Orb Garchomp AKA the best Mon in the entire format

It’s not revolutionary or as creative as some of the other team choices, but Supporting the best Mons well is a recipe for success(3/10)

The base synergy is this — Mega Delphox is probably the best Mega into Zard Y and Floette. Staraptor haaates those guys but does really well into the things Delphox doesn’t like such as Rain and Sand! (2/10)

Team Spotlight: StarPhox!

This team won a big VR Tour piloted by @PHSFeitosa and showed Staraptor isn’t a 1 trick Pony! I think that this team has what it takes to be a top Meta threat as we get closer to Worlds! So let’s explore what makes this duo so threatening rn! (1/10)
